channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Iran says US ‘not serious’ about talks; ship ablaze off Iraq
item.description: Iran says the United States is "not serious" about negotiations as UKMTO reports a ship on fire off the coast of Iraq.

item.title: Jordan launches air strikes in Syria in response to a fatal church shooting
item.description: Syria denies prior coordination with Jordan after deadly air strikes hit two provinces, killing at least seven people.

item.title: Jordan attacks Syria in response to Karak church attack
item.description: Jordan’s air force has carried out several strikes in southern Syria in response to Friday’s church attack.

item.title: England’s Harry Kane wins Ballon d’Or, Alexia Putellas takes women’s award
item.description: Bayern Munich striker becomes the first Englishman to win the prestigious award in 25 years, after Michael Owen in 2001.

item.title: Africa food security under threat due to Iran war, trade officials warn
item.description: The war on Iran is driving up fuel and fertiliser costs across Africa, threatening food security, trade officials say.

item.title: Jordan arrests three suspects over deadly church attack
item.description: Jordanian authorities have arrested three relatives over a church attack in Karak that killed eight people.

item.title: Nurse killed in attack while responding to Ebola alert in DR Congo
item.description: Local youths reportedly accused the health workers of contaminating water sources and spreading Ebola.

item.title: More than 60 Christians killed in Ethiopia 'massacre', church official says
item.description: One resident, whose 75-year-old father was killed, described it as an ambush, saying they were surrounded.

item.title: Why Israel's election is one of the most important in its history
item.description: Security and democracy emerge as central issues in Israel's highly anticipated general election, as Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson reports.

item.title: Israel and the US are both going to the polls - the consequences will be global
item.description: The next fortnight sees two elections on different continents. The outcomes will shape geopolitics and the global economy, writes James Landale
